title: WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.26867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that speak together, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we open-source WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that pairs confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment with multivariate polynomial commitments. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three known datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the best benchmarks by up to 20x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 39x. translated_title: WaveCommitments：私密且可验证的语音智能体市场
translated_abstract: 现代语音系统正在演变为由自主语音智能体组成的生态系统，这些智能体协同发声、协商并交易诸如嵌入向量、频谱图或原始数据等资产。在这类市场中，出于隐私约束，卖家无法公开资产供评估，而买家也无法为其无法测试的东西定价。因此，我们开源了WaveCommitments，这是一种端到端设计，将可信执行环境内基于Data Shapley的机密资产估值与多元多项式承诺相结合。它支持选择性公开和防篡改溯源，能够证明交付的资产与估值相符，同时隐藏其他所有信息。我们在三个知名数据集上，使用包括Whisper在内的最先进编码器，针对多种任务进行了大量实验，结果表明我们的方法将最佳基准的速度提升了最高20倍，同时将证明大小缩减了最高39倍。我们还系统地研究了说话人的价值如何随任务变化而偏移。
tldr: 提出WaveCommitments，一种将可信执行环境内基于Data Shapley的机密资产估值与多元多项式承诺相结合的端到端设计，实现了语音智能体市场中私密且可验证的资产交易，相比最佳基准速度提升最高20倍、证明大小缩减最高39倍。
en_tdlr: WaveCommitments is an end-to-end design that pairs Data Shapley-based confidential asset valuation inside trusted execution environments with multivariate polynomial commitments, enabling private and verifiable speech-agent marketplaces with up to 20x speedup and up to 39x smaller proof sizes over the best benchmarks.
